title: Solo pianists at Basin Street and the Original Dixieland band
summary: He did not hear Basin Street or the Original Dixieland Jazz Band.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: Yeah, that makes it nice. Yeah. We never get too much about solo piano players. You didn't go around to Basin Street. Was that open when you were going around?
Darius Dorman Oakland Hmm, we've got it here. What about the original Dixieland Jazz Band? Did you ever hear that?
Yeah, no, no, the original, no I thought you meant the original Dixieland Tuxedo. No, that's before my time, that's Lorac and them.
Yeah, but they did come back some, didn't they?
I don't remember hearing them at all.
